desc: Prove rigorously how one operation transforms the three affected gaps and preserves all other gaps.
Establish that repeated operations allow arbitrary permutations within the odd-indexed gaps and within the even-indexed gaps.
Derive the weighted-gap expression for the sum of all coordinates.
Design an \(O(N\log N)\) algorithm that sorts each parity class and pairs its gaps with descending weights.
Implement the solution using 64-bit-safe integer arithmetic and output the minimum sum.
